claims.text: Finnish consumer confidence remained weak in April 2026, supporting a defensive value-led retail stance.
Capgemini frames value as a mix of transparent pricing, quality, trust, emotional connection, and AI-assisted shopping rather than discounting alone.
NIQ identifies seamless commerce, social commerce, quick commerce, and retail media as converging into a single shopper ecosystem.
Nordic commerce sources support the need for connected delivery, pickup, return, and digital journey design.
Fashion consideration is shifting, requiring clearer differentiation and more intentional category curation.
Consumers still allow intentional indulgence when reliability, quality, and emotional value are clear.
Finnish and Nordic circularity sources support repair, reuse, and traceability as credible retail themes.
The European consumer agenda supports stronger consumer protection, sustainability, and informed choices.
Bank of Finland analysis supports ageing and a shrinking working-age population as structural long-term forces in Finland.
Mintel's 2026 predictions support blurred life stages and reinvention across older age groups.
NIQ identifies retail media networks as reshaping commerce and retailer monetisation.
Nepa links retail media, AI-mediated discovery, and evidence-based category growth for Nordic FMCG planning in 2026.
NIQ identifies Health & Beauty as a stronger engagement category with more frequent shopping occasions in leading markets.
Nepa frames health behaviour and functional choices as linked 2026 Nordic FMCG growth priorities.
NRF forecasts US retail sales growth of 4.4% in 2026, supporting a resilient but selective spending baseline.
Deloitte reports value-seeking as a structural consumer-products issue, with shoppers expecting more value for the price.
U.S. Census e-commerce data supports e-commerce as a material part of US retail, requiring physical centres to integrate pickup, returns, and fulfilment.
Mall of America provides an official destination benchmark for combining scale, attractions, events, and flagship retail.
Deloitte's value-seeking analysis supports repair, trade-in, and product-life-extension services as practical value propositions.
McKinsey's wellness research supports health, appearance, fitness, nutrition, and mindfulness as cross-age consumer priorities.
EMARKETER forecasts US retail media ad spending growth in 2026, supporting retail media as a monetisation layer.
Coresight identifies in-store retail media as a growing retail monetisation and shopper-engagement opportunity.
Circana reports growth in US prestige and mass beauty retail in 2025, supporting beauty as a proven frequency category.
McKinsey finds wellness demand spanning health, sleep, nutrition, fitness, appearance, and mindfulness, supporting wellness-service clustering.
Deloitte identifies AI-enabled demand and a changing value chain as forces that make connected retail planning more important.
NRF forecasts 2026 US retail sales growth, supporting a selective growth rather than no-growth mall planning baseline.
Reuters reports Hormuz shipping disruption, stranded tankers and cancelled war-risk cover, supporting logistics and insurance risk for UAE malls.
CBUAE forecasts strong UAE growth but identifies regional conflicts, commodity prices and risk premia as downside risks.
Reuters reports the UAE said it would leave OPEC and OPEC+ from May 1, 2026, supporting the energy-autonomy scenario.
Reuters reports UAE officials framing strategic autonomy and a review of multilateral ties after the OPEC exit.
Dubai DET reports 19.59 million international visitors in 2025, supporting tourism as a UAE mall demand base.
Reuters reports continued Iran-war negotiation deadlock and Hormuz risk, supporting the need to make safe-hub operations explicit.
